+async def reap_orphans() -> int:
+    redis = get_redis()
+    try:
+        keys = await redis.keys("pending_image:*")
+    except Exception:
+        keys = []
+
+    reaped = 0
+    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=24)
+
+    referenced: set[str] = set()
+    try:
+        from bazaar_api.db.session import session_factory
+
+        async with session_factory()() as session, session.begin():
+            result = await session.execute(text("SELECT image_keys FROM listings"))
+            for (image_keys,) in result:
+                for k in image_keys or []:
+                    referenced.add(k)
+    except Exception:
+        referenced = set()
+
+    client = _get_r2_client()
+    r2_bucket = os.getenv("R2_BUCKET", "bazaar-media")
+
+    for redis_key in keys:
+        raw = await redis.get(redis_key)
+        if not raw:
+            continue
+        try:
+            meta = json.loads(raw)
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        created_at_str = meta.get("created_at")
+        try:
+            created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at_str)
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        if created_at.tzinfo is None:
+            created_at = created_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+
+        image_key = meta.get("image_key")
+        if not image_key:
+            continue
+        if image_key in referenced:
+            continue
+        if created_at > cutoff:
+            continue
+
+        try:
+            if client is not None:
+                client.delete_object(Bucket=r2_bucket, Key=image_key)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        await redis.delete(redis_key)
+        reaped += 1
+
+    return reaped

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_idempotency_same_timestamp_rejected_as_hmac_replay():
+    """HMAC nonce is single-use — same timestamp/signature must be rejected as replay BEFORE idempotency.
+    Enforces verify_signature before idempotency_guard. Naive idempotency-first impl would return 200 replay instead of 401."""
+    listing_id = await _insert_listing()
+    body = {"acting_user_id": SELLER, "content_type": "image/jpeg", "content_length": 1024}
+    body_bytes = _body_json(body)
+    path = f"/v1/listings/{listing_id}/images"
+    idem_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
+    ts = _next_ts()
+    sig = _sign("POST", path, "", ts, body_bytes)
+    headers = {
+        "X-Bazaar-Key": KEY_ID,
+        "X-Bazaar-Timestamp": ts,
+        "X-Bazaar-Signature": sig,
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        "Idempotency-Key": idem_key,
+    }
+    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as client:
+        r1 = await client.post(path, content=body_bytes, headers=headers)
+        r2 = await client.post(path, content=body_bytes, headers=headers)  # same ts/sig
+    assert r1.status_code == 200, r1.text
+    # Second call must be rejected as HMAC replay (401), not idempotency replay (200)
+    assert r2.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401 replay detection, got {r2.status_code}: {r2.text}"
+    assert "replay" in r2.text.lower() or "REPLAY_DETECTED" in r2.text
